messages:
mike_h: CI red on main: tests failing in runtime/shim_test (flaky?). Run link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/runs/987654321. Anyone can help bisect or retrigger targeted shards? I don't want to rebuild images.

anya: saw it, looks like integration-shard-4 failing on timeout. Probably flaky. You can rerun just the job from the GH UI: Actions -> the run -> Re-run failed jobs. That avoids rebuilding the image :+1:

sam: CLI option works too: `gh run rerun 987654321 --failed` — this reuses existing job artifacts.

jia: note: if your workflow's 'build' job is a dependency, GH won't rebuild artifacts for re-run; it's safe for matrix test reruns. For Buildkite we'd do `bk retry`.

oncall-bot: CI run 987654321 marked flakiness score=0.71 (3 fails in 7d). Recommend bisect: run the failing test locally with a narrowed commit range.

sam: quick snippets:

```
# rerun via github cli (surgical job)
gh run rerun 987654321 --job test-linux-shard-4
# rerun only failed jobs
gh run rerun 987654321 --failed
```

jia: if you need to trigger a fresh workflow without image build (minimal run), our helper accepts --no-image:

```
./ci/trigger_workflow.sh --workflow=tests --commit=<<sha>> --no-image
```

anya: pinging @eng-infra for manual approval if we need to force a re-run that touches build steps :wave:

devops: I can trigger the rerun/force if you drop the run link + short justification.

mike_h: trying `gh run rerun 987654321 --failed` now, will report back.

mike_h: rerun finished, shard-4 passed, all tests green 🎉. Thanks everyone :tada:
